name: DRIFT
summary: DRIFT was a low-pressure negative-ion-TPC directional dark-matter programme at Boulby, measuring nuclear-recoil tracks rather than energy alone.
detection_principle: Electrons attach to electronegative gases such as CS2 and drift as negative ions, reducing diffusion. Multiwire readout and distinct ion-drift components enable three-dimensional tracking and absolute-depth reconstruction.

results.summary: Directional dark-matter constraints were obtained, alongside studies of unshielded nuclear-recoil backgrounds consistent with fast neutrons from the surrounding rock.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
